title: 第196章 霜月之子第一届大胃王比赛
slug: 在须弥假装是一个学者
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“客官，您这是……”伙计没有说话，这掌柜的倒是站了出来。老板不在这个地方，那么他就需要顶上去。就好像战斗当中师长不在岗位，那副师长就必须要负责战斗当中的一切事宜。当然，他也只是个打工的。

不过，他瞬间便想到了一些事情。想到了夏广他们的家族。为什么会想到这些呢？呵呵，他们可是大名鼎鼎的猎魔人呐！他们对魔气有着天然的克制。

“你可有看见此人。”阴山双剑中的弟弟，拿出一个水晶球来一指，球中立刻投出一个影像，正是自己之前未易容的样子。

“呵呵……”独孤鸿有些尴尬的看向她，一时之间也是有些语塞。边上的玄机子和轩辕浩天则是十分暧昧的笑了起来。虽然没有笑出声，可是也让雨柔感觉到粉脸通红。直接低着头不说话，秒变鸵鸟了。

“我若不曾记错，东王公长居东海，这门下异兽却是如何到了这里？”还这般为难于人。

他非常清楚的感知到有人出现了。至于究竟是什么修为，他到现在都没有能够完全搞清楚。不过，他还是将全部的注意力都集中到了他所布置的范围当中。

就在这个时候，整个殡仪馆的四周忽然传来了一阵古钟敲响的声音。

金染这会子刚被大师傅撕了一块皮，疼的恨不能死，却怎么也死不了。哪里有心思回答她的问题？

“我已经是个老头子了，哪有那么多的精力？能把自己的事情做好就不错了。”向南也进步了不少，能够坦然应对黄飞了。

“不是，不是。”落尘摆摆手，连忙四下里去找杯盏。找了一圈没找着，便将手中勺子递了过去。虽不合适，也能凑合用吧？

因为一旦得罪了龙组，再出现那种特殊的情况他们可根本没有办法。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Sir, what are you..." The waiter didn't say anything, but the shopkeeper stood up.If the boss is not here, then he needs to step up.Just like the division commander is not at his post during the battle, the deputy division commander must be responsible for all matters during the battle.Of course, he is just a part-time worker.

However, he suddenly thought of something.Thinking of Xia Guang and his family.Why do you think of this?Haha, they are famous demon hunters!They have natural restraint against evil spirits.

"Have you seen this person?" The younger brother in the Yinshan Double Swords took out a crystal ball and pointed at it, and an image was immediately projected in the ball, which was exactly what he looked like before he was disguised.

"Haha..." Duguhong looked at her awkwardly, and was speechless for a moment.Xuanjizi and Xuanyuan Haotian beside them laughed very ambiguously.Although she didn't laugh out loud, Yurou felt her face turn red.He just lowered his head and said nothing, instantly turning into an ostrich.

"If I remember correctly, the Duke of the East has lived in the East China Sea for a long time. How did this strange beast come here?" It's so embarrassing.

He sensed someone's presence very clearly.As for what kind of cultivation it is, he has not been able to fully understand it until now.However, he still focused all his attention on the area he had arranged.

At this moment, the sound of ancient bells ringing suddenly came from all around the funeral home.

Jin Ran had just been torn off a piece of his skin by his master. It hurt so much that he wanted to die, but he couldn't.Where can I find the time to answer her questions?

"I'm already an old man, how can I have so much energy? It would be nice if I could do my own thing well." Xiang Nan has also made a lot of progress and can deal with Huang Fei calmly.

"No, no." Luochen waved his hand and quickly looked around for a cup.After searching around and not finding it, he handed over the spoon in his hand.Even though it’s not suitable, it can still be used, right?

Because once they offend the Dragon Group, there is nothing they can do if that special situation occurs again.
